henry: scheduling a private dedicated rollout for Aventis. Quiet window: 2026-06-12 01:30-03:30 UTC. Plan: isolated KV priming (synthetic) 10m before -> 5% canary for 12m -> 25% for 18m -> hold, then final outside window. Image pinned: `relay-3.4.0-beta` (primary), fallback `relay-3.3.2`. This build has a decoder-optim tweak; want to validate tail latency. tagging eng-ops + eng-security for signoff.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary aventis at 2026-06-12T01:35:00Z (job id cb-1769990000). Metric cadence: 3m samples. Audit logging flag will be set for the run.

tasha: ack. propose gates: p95 < 185ms AND error rate < 0.4% for two consecutive samples to progress. also require tokens/s >= 90% of baseline before moving beyond 25%.

eng-ops: ack and i'll be on watch. set autopause: pause if p95 > 230ms OR errors > 1% for any 2 consecutive samples; emergency rollback if 3 consecutive breaches.

kyle: quick KV note  priming synthetic traffic should include hot-key fanout to avoid eviction storm. recommend 12k synthetic reqs over 6m.

eng-security: checked KMS calendar  no rotations in window. enable audit flag and verbose logging for `/v1/chat` route.

audit-bot: audit logging toggled ON for tenant aventis (aventis.audit=true).

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-06-12T01:35:20Z. run cb-1769990000-run1. KV prime began at 01:25:30Z.

deploy-bot: metrics sample (3m): p50=34ms, p95=168ms, errors=0.21%, tokens/s=92% baseline. KV prime observed brief eviction spike ~40s then stable.

tasha: first sample looks good. hold for next sample.

deploy-bot: metrics sample (6m): p50=36ms, p95=174ms, errors=0.29%, tokens/s=91% baseline. Gate satisfied for move to 25%.

deploy-bot: progressing to 25% at 2026-06-12T01:47:10Z. will post next snapshots.

deploy-bot: metrics sample (3m at 25%): p50=38ms, p95=186ms, errors=0.45%, tokens/s=88% baseline.

eng-ops: error rate breached our 0.4% gate (0.45%). autopause requires 2 consecutive breaches; this is 1. hold at 25% while we debug.

kyle: spinning targeted debug traces for 5% of failed requests to check upstream routing and retries.

henry: emergency rollback command if needed (use for audit):
```
/rollout rollback --tenant aventis --to relay-3.3.2 --reason "canary regression" --ticket AVT-880
```
please react with :eyes: once acknowledged.

tasha: :eyes:

eng-security: :eyes: will ensure logs include rollback reason.

deploy-bot: metrics sample (6m): p50=37ms, p95=178ms, errors=0.33%, tokens/s=90% baseline. breach cleared.

eng-ops: breach cleared. require one more stable sample before final hold decision.

deploy-bot: metrics sample (3m): p50=36ms, p95=171ms, errors=0.28%, tokens/s=93% baseline.

tasha: two stable samples confirmed. proceed to hold and schedule drain outside quiet window. I'll coordinate final rollout timeline with support.

henry: drafting release note: will include pinned image, fallback, gating thresholds, KV prime recipe, debug trace findings (upstream 429 bursts fixed by routing tweak), and rollback command.

audit-bot: release note created (internal): https://redwood.internal/releases/aventis/relay-3.4.0-beta-canary.

deploy-bot: canary job cb-1769990000 completed SUCCESS at 2026-06-12T01:58:05Z.
